text_block_list.text:
During lunch, Уиннинг Тикит seems
different
from her usual self.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Aaagh, I'm starving! But I can't seem to
stomach
anything...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I've been dozing off lately too! How am I

supposed to... go full... power...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
She seems to be exhausted. Maybe I
need to
revise her race schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
